title_en: Thrilljoy Unveils Terrifyingly Cute Pennywise Figures: Get an Exclusive First Look At These IT: Welcome to Derry Toys
summary_en: Thrilljoy is tackling the terrifying clowns of IT: Welcome to Derry as part of its PIX! line of vinyl figures, and Pennywise has never looked so cute.
body_en:
Thrilljoy is tackling the HBO series IT: Welcome to Derry for the latest addition to its PIX! line of vinyl toys. If you crave a cutesy yet still oddly terrifying version of killer clowns Pennywise and Periwinkle, you're in luck.
IGN can exclusively debut the first photos of the IT: Welcome to Derry PIX! figures. Get a closer look in the slideshow gallery below:
In all, there are three figures featured in this blind box line, one standard version and two limited chase variants. The "hero edition" features a classic version of Bill Skarsgård's Pennywise the Dancing Clown and is limited to 9,999 units worldwide.
As for the chase figures, the first is a 1:6 variant that depicts Madeleine Stowe's Ingrid Kersh in her Periwinkle costume. The second is a very rare variant of Pennywise soaked in blood, which is limited to just 96 pieces.
All three figures measure slightly under 5 inches in height. They retail for $20 each, with preorders opening on the Thrilljoy website on August 28 at 8am PT.
IT: Welcome to Derry was recently renewed for a second season on HBO . Based on the finale, we have some ideas for where the series can go next .
